structured.answer: If my money stays in the עו"ש it just shrinks. The page said 10,000 ₪ turns into 8,203 ₪ "בכסף של היום" after 10 years, so my 30k would lose a few thousand too. Something called a "קרן כספית יומית" came out higher (10,779 ₪), but I don't really know what it is, so for now it's just "get it out of the עו"ש".
